summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor with some authorization checks and basic CRUD for categories/vendors/payment methods/expenses/revenue (revenue appears simplified), plus a React/TanStack Router frontend with Internet Identity login gating, dashboard shell/theme/print CSS, Expenses + Revenue CRUD UIs, and Master Data management UI. COGS and Reports pages are placeholders (“Coming Soon”), and the Excel-matching calculation/reporting requirements are not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persistent backend data models and CRUD APIs for Expenses, Sales/Revenue, COGS, Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods with fields aligned to spreadsheet columns, including stable persistence across upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend evidence shows Expenses and a simplified Revenue model, but no COGS model/CRUD is shown; Sales/Revenue fields do not match requested grossSales + per-platform percentages + netProfit/raw fields; stable storage/preupgrade/postupgrade (or migration strategy) is not evidenced in the provided backend snippet.

missing_requirements.requirement: Form-based UI for entering/editing Expenses, Sales/Revenue (with per-platform percentages and net profit per Excel logic), and COGS, with validation and table views.
missing_requirements.reason: Expenses and Revenue pages show table/form patterns, but Revenue UI does not show per-platform percentage inputs or net profit; COGS page is explicitly a placeholder (“Coming Soon”) rather than a CRUD form/table UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend prevents deleting master data that is in use (or provides safe strategy like soft-delete/archiving), and master-data screens exist for Categories, Vendors, Payment Methods used across entry forms.
missing_requirements.reason: Master data UI exists, and Expenses uses category/vendor/payment method dropdowns, but backend deletion safety is not evidenced; shown backend deleteCategory simply removes the category without any in-use checks.

missing_requirements.requirement: Automatic calculations (category totals, monthly/annual summaries, P&L, margins, platform fees) matching Excel formulas 1:1, with a documented formula-definition location and automated tests against sample inputs/expected outputs.
missing_requirements.reason: No calculation engine/formula module, no explicit platform fee logic, no documented place to adjust formulas, and no automated tests are evidenced in the diff summary; dashboard data source/useDashboardData is referenced but not shown to implement Excel-matching calculations.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dashboard with KPIs for selectable time windows (day, month, last 3/6/12 months) with color-coded indicators and configurable margin threshold, driven by backend APIs.
missing_requirements.reason: UI includes a time-window selector and KPI cards with color semantics, but configurable threshold is hard-coded (profitMargin >= 20/10) and backend/API computation for the time windows is not evidenced in provided files.

missing_requirements.requirement: Report views (daily, monthly expense, monthly P&L, 3/6/12-month, annual) with spreadsheet-style layout and print-friendly rendering via browser print styles.
missing_requirements.reason: Reports page is a placeholder (“Coming Soon”) and does not implement the required report views or selectors; print CSS exists but report layouts themselves are not implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-token-based access-control initialization via a secret URL parameter (caffeineAdminToken) and a backend call _initializeAccessControlWithSecret.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies Internet Identity auth (no extra auth mechanisms). Introducing a URL-secret admin token is an additional, unrequested authentication/authorization mechanism.

hallucinated_features.description: Branding/marketing-style footer link with UTM parameters to caffeine.ai and “Built with ❤️”.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals include not building a marketing site; this footer branding/linking is not requested as part of the internal accounting app requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media icon imports (react-icons/si: Facebook/X/LinkedIn) in AppShell.
hallucinated_features.reason: No social/marketing integration is requested for an internal accounting tool; these imports appear unrelated to the specified requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile setup flow (prompting for a user name after login) and user profile storage endpoints.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in requirements (which focus on accounting data CRUD, calculations, dashboards, and reports). It may be useful, but it is additional scope beyond the stated requirements.
